jobs.description: Perum DAMRI adalah Badan Usaha Milik Negara yang bergerak di bidang transportasi jalan. Perusahaan Umum (Perum DAMRI) adalah singkatan dari Djawatan Angkoetan Motor Republik Indonesia adalah sebuah Badan Usaha Milik Negara Indonesia yang bergerak di bidang transportasi darat. Lowongan Kerja Perusahaan Umum (Perum) DAMRI. Dalam perkembangan selanjutnya sebagai sebuah perusahaan umum (Perum), nama DAMRI tetap diabadikan sebagai brand mark dari perusahaan yang hingga saat ini masih tetap konsisten menjalankan tugasnya sebagai salah satu penyelenggara jasa angkutan penumpang dan barang dengan menggunakan bus dan truk. Kantor pusat Perusahaan Umum (Perum) DAMRI beralamat di Jl. Matraman Raya No. 25, RT.2/RW.1, Palmeriam, Kec. Matraman, Jakarta Timur JK 13140, Indonesia. Visi: Menjadi Perusahaan transportasi jalan kelas dunia yang berkinerja unggul dan berkelanjutan dengan memberikan pelayanan yang berkualitas bagi pelanggan untuk mendukung konektivitas nasional. jobs.description: About Vercel : Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Federal (Intelligence Community Focus)
jobs.description: Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Trusted by the U.S. Department of War and Fortune 500s, our platform runs on-premises and in private clouds, delivering secure messaging, file sharing, workflow automation, audio/screenshare, and project management—all with full data and operational control. Mattermost powers high-stakes workflows across mission planning, real-time, real-world operations, DevSecOps, incident response, and cyber defense—enabling secure collaboration from tactical edge and DDIL environments to enterprise HQ. Teams operate across web, desktop, and mobile, with embedded interoperability for Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365. To learn more, visit www.mattermost.com Mattermost is seeking a Senior Account Executive – Federal (Intelligence Community Focus) to own and expand one of our most strategic territories, centered on the U.S. Intelligence Community. This is a quota-carrying individual contributor role focused exclusively on strategic selling, renewal expansion, and net-new growth across the IC ecosystem. The territory includes a significant multi-million-dollar renewal footprint and substantial opportunity for expansion across IC agencies, program offices, and mission-aligned organizations operating in some of the most sensitive and demanding environments in the world. The ideal candidate brings deep IC domain expertise, established relationships across agency acquisition and mission stakeholders, and experience working with Federal Systems Integrators and cleared partners to accelerate program-level adoption. What You'll Do Own and Grow the Intelligence Community Territory Serve as the primary seller responsible for Mattermost's IC business, including agencies across the IC, program offices, and mission-aligned stakeholders operating in classified and controlled environments Develop and execute multi-year account strategies aligned to IC modernization

jobs.title: Team Lead - Invoices
jobs.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role Invoices is BLP's largest product. Every day, it decides whether a supplier invoice can be posted to the customer's ERP without a human touching it. The invoice team builds and runs that product. This is a leadership job with three parts that are equally important: Build the team. The team is growing fast and is distributed across Zurich and several European countries. You hire, onboard, and grow engineers, and you develop the subteam leads who will carry more of the line management as we scale. Deliver for our biggest customers. You won’t own the decisions, but you’ll shape them. You’ll roll up your sleeves to prototype and demonstrate what good looks like, while making sure your clients understand the reasoning well enough to own the outcome. This role suits someone with the technical depth of a tech lead, and the judgement, communication skills and patience to lead through influence rather than authority. You’ll need to work fluently in English and in at least one of Spanish or Portuguese. This is an individual contributor role with deep platform and governance ownership, rather than a people-management track. Your impact and progression come from the scale and quality of the systems, frameworks, and cross-team relationships you build, not from growing a team. jobs.title: Talent Partner - Manufacturing and Industrial
jobs.description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. We're scaling incredibly fast, and our manufacturing capability is central to our future. As our Talent Partner, you'll be focused on hiring workers across the manufacturing lifecycle. What You Will Do Develop and nurture talent pools across the manufacturing space, such as facilities managers and factory technicians, to ensure consistent delivery across high-volume pipelines. Build a robust employer brand, enabling microagi to be known as a competitive employer in an emerging industrial startup ecosystem. Advise the team on best practices for building out and scaling manufacturing recruiting. Plan and attend industry events to further our market presence amongst the best manufacturing talent. jobs.title: Enterprise Product Manager
jobs.description: Enterprise Product Manager The Role Lyrebird is already trusted by thousands of clinicians, and the largest health organisations in Australia and the UK are now rolling it out across their entire workforce. This is a new role, created to lead the next chapter of our enterprise product as those deployments grow in size and ambition. You'll own the enterprise product end to end: the core platform capability that serves every enterprise customer, and the tailored work that deepens our partnership with specific ones. You'll have a real roadmap, a real engineering team, and the scope to shape where enterprise goes next. A good week in this role might include a roadmap session with a state health service's IT team, a deep dive with a private hospital group to understand what's behind their latest request and how it could become something every enterprise customer benefits from, and a morning with engineering working out which of three competing priorities goes first. Your customers are the people deploying Lyrebird across their organisation, not the clinicians themselves, so you'll spend more time in customer conversations than most PMs do. If you enjoy that mix, and like being the person who makes the call when everything seems urgent, you'll do well here. The Security team protects OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but operational in how we execute, and we support every product and research effort at OpenAI. Our tenets include prioritizing for impact, enabling researchers and developers, preparing for future transformative technologies, and fostering a strong, collaborative security culture. InfraSec safeguards the core of OpenAI’s research and production environments—GPU supercomputing clusters, multi-cloud infrastructure, datacenters, networking, storage, and the critical services that power our frontier AI models. Our charter spans everything from bare-metal hardware and firmware to Kubernetes clusters, service meshes, and the data pathways that carry highly sensitive model weights and user data. As a Security Software Engineer, you will design and build critical foundational services, such as authentication systems, egress/ingress proxies, access brokers, and key management platforms, that demand high standards of reliability, scalability, and software craftsmanship. Verantwortung für Custom‑Code‑Management, inklusive Analyse, Stilllegung und Refactoring im Sinne der Clean-Core-Prinzipien. Design und Governance von Integrations- und Schnittstellenarchitekturen (RFC, IDoc, APIs, OData, Webservices) gemäß SAP ISA‑M. Sicherstellung der Kompatibilität mit Drittanbieter‑Add-ons und Legacy-Systemen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, IT, Key‑Usern sowie Vertrieb/Presales. Erstellung und Präsentation von Entscheidungsvorlagen, Management-Briefings sowie Risiko- und Impact-Analysen. Architektonischer Input zu Governance, Security, Change Management, Tests, Schulungen und Post-Go-Live-Aktivitäten. jobs.title: Stage 3 Mois - 35H - Conseiller De Vente (H/F) - Montaigne
jobs.location: Boutique Montaigne, Paris, Île de France
jobs.description: LA MAISON Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai. VOTRE RÔLE En tant que Conseiller(ère) de vente, vous serez ambassadeur / ambassadrice de la Maison et vous jouerez un rôle essentiel afin d’offrir à chaque client une expérience unique dans le respect et l’engagement de la Maison Jacquemus. Vous vous efforcerez de découvrir la personnalité de vos clients et d'identifier leurs désirs, tout en leur faisant découvrir l’ADN de la Maison et tous les univers produits. VOS MISSIONS · Participer activement au développement du chiffre d’affaires en accompagnant l’équipe dans l’atteinte des objectifs du point de vente. · Accueillir et conseiller nos clients pour

The platform you build powers our AI and analytics, making clean, reliable, well-modeled data essential. Whether you're an experienced engineer ready to own the platform or a strong mid-level engineer eager to grow into the role, we'd love to hear from you. Your position in our team Build and optimize cloud-native data pipelines on AWS — ETL/ELT and the infrastructure underneath (Aurora, Redshift, dbt, Spark/EMR, Airflow, CDC) — using AI tooling as a standard part of the workflow. Design and evolve the data models that power analytics, operational use cases, and AI/ML across thousands of studios. Help raise the bar on data reliability — embed governance, testing, and lineage so both people and AI systems can trust the numbers by default. Partner with product, and other engineering teams to turn ambiguous business problems into robust data solutions. Evaluate and evolve new approaches with us — data mesh patterns, and emerging AI tooling — and help decide what genuinely earns a place in our stack. Grow into our financial and regulatory reporting workstream (Finion Capital), where correctness and auditability matter most. Your profile 3+ years in data engineering with a focus on data warehousing — and the appetite to take on more ownership than you've held so far. Strong SQL and Python for data work. Working with AI tools feels natural to you — and, just as important, the judgment to review and validate what they produce. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. La practice RetailTech regroupe nos clients du retail et de l'e-commerce : des acteurs qui transforment l'expérience d'achat de millions d'utilisateurs, en magasin comme en ligne. Elle rassemble les équipes produit, tech et design qui les accompagnent au quotidien sur des programmes à fort enjeu business. C'est un domaine en pleine structuration : on y construit la communauté produit, on outille le staffing, on anime les rituels collectifs (all-hands, dojos) et on contribue aux avant-ventes pour faire grandie le portefeuille. Ton équipe : Tu rejoindras une communauté tech : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien. Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs. Le tech lead a pour objectif de te faire réussir : il te fait réfléchir aux problématiques que tu rencontres et en t’aidant à te débloquer. Tu pourras le solliciter à tout moment pour t’aider à progre

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Pôle Run - CDI Paris - Theodo Cloud
jobs.description: L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Elle propose une offre d’infogérance nouvelle génération, respectant l'exigence ITIL 4, tout en combinant TMA applicative, opérations cloud (HDS) et amélioration continue accélérée par l’IA. Ton équipe : L’équipe technique de Theodo Cloud est constituée de deux pôles : - le pôle Build, dédié à nos projets de création, migration et optimisation d’infrastructures - le pôle Run, dédié à l’infogérance des infrastructures de nos clients. Notre pôle Run connaît une forte croissance et recherche un Site Reliability Engineer pour renforcer l’équipe et ainsi pouvoir développer le nombre de clients infogérés par Theodo. L’équipe Run est composée de 7 personnes, intervenant sur de la réaction à incident, du maintien en conditions opérationnelles des infrastructures et des optimisations. Tes missions : En tant que SRE Run, ton rôle est d’assurer la stabilité et la disponibilité des infrastructures de nos clients : - Réagir aux incidents en production et mener des investigations en cas de problèmes techniques - Réaliser les post-mortem et assurer la communication avec le client - Répondre aux interrogations de nos clients et leur fournir des recommandations pour améliorer la qualité de leur infrastructure. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
jobs.description: The role Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production. We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product. When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at. The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go. The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it. In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading. This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it We are growing our product design team and looking for an experienced mobile designer to expand features on our Android and iOS apps. You will have the opportunity to make financial services more accessible and inclusive for millions of people through working with thoughtful product managers, researchers, and engineers! In this role, you'll: Work closely with product managers, user researchers, engineers, and data analysts from the start to end of a feature. Create high quality designs, interactions, and prototypes to explore ideas in service of the best solution for the project (Wave uses Figma). Craft user research plans and work directly with our user researchers to identify problems and validate solutions in user testing. Contribute to Wave's design system and component library. We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support you

jobs.title: Certification Program Manager
jobs.description: We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health. Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar. Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale. About the role As a Certification Program Manager at Scarlet, you will help safe medical technologies reach patients sooner by running and improving the operations behind their certification. You will own operational delivery across customer certification programs, working closely with auditors, assessors and account managers. This is a hands-on role: delivering detailed work accurately and on time, while finding ways to make certification simpler and more efficient. As Scarlet expands into new markets and jurisdictions, you will help shape the processes that support that growth. You’ll build expertise across a varied range of certification activities, with scope to take ownership of broader operational improvements. Responsibilities Plan and coordinate certification programs, including client considerations and audit time calculations, and improve how milestones, dependencies and follow-up activities are managed. Review applications and shape project plans, identifying device codes, required assessments and assessor competence requirements, while streamlining routine checks. Prepare certificates following approved certification decisions and coordinate surveillance and renewals, simplifying administration. Streamline certificate transfers by coordinating next steps with customers and outgoing certification bodies. Triage medical device change notifications

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description: About Kustomer Kustomer is the AI-native customer experience platform that turns every interaction into a lasting relationship and a measurable business outcome. By unifying customer data, conversations and AI-native workflows into a single connected timeline, Kustomer helps teams cultivate customers, not tickets, resolving issues faster and delivering more personalized service across every channel. Today, Kustomer is the core platform for leading customer service brands like Sweetgreen, Starz, Vuori, Goldbelly and Cotopaxi. Founded in 2015 by serial entrepreneurs Brad Birnbaum and Jeremy Suriel, Kustomer raised nearly $200M in funding culminating in a Series E before being acquired by Meta in a deal that closed in 2022. In 2023, Kustomer's founders and original investors, Battery, Redpoint, and Boldstart Ventures, spun the company back out with a $60M investment as an independent, privately held business ready to focus more deeply on AI. In 2025, Norwest led our Series B, bringing our total funding to $90M. This momentum allowed Kustomer to double down on AI-native innovation and build a sharper roadmap for the future of customer experience. Our Krew is a remote-friendly team spread across the U.S. with hubs in NYC and London. We gather in person each year at our annual Kustomer Kick-Off event and always look for Krew members who are curious, collaborative, and ready to shape the future of Customer Experience. About the Role Kustomer’s AI agent resolves routine questions, and our support partners handle the next layer of straightforward requests. This role handles what’s left: complex, ambiguous technical issues across webhooks, APIs, workflows, integrations, and AI agent behavior. You’ll be the final escalation point before Engineering. You’ll also make Tier 1 and 2 stronger by turning each hard case into a runbook, a fix, or a product improvement. jobs.description: Who are we? At UpGuard , we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk. We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface. We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale. Where does this role fit in? A2 (Automation & AI) is UpGuard's central team for getting value out of AI and automation. We discover how work actually happens across the business, build the automations and AI tools that make it faster, and help every team run them on their own. Demand is growing faster than the team, so we need an AI & Automation Analyst to help us keep up. As an AI & Automation Analyst, you'll be a business analyst first, with a hands-on streak. Working day to day with our lead analyst, you'll map how other teams really work, rethink those processes for the era of AI, and turn that into clear requirements. Our engineers handle the complex builds; you'll take the quick, simple ones off their plate. You'll also reshape how A2 itself works, starting with the team's AI harness: the shared context, Skills, connectors and light automations that let the team work in new ways, not just faster ones. It's a role for someone who learns fast, communicates clearly and wants to be at the front of how AI changes the way What will you do? Run process discovery with the lead analyst: interviewing and shadowing teams, mapping how work actually happens (as-is and to-be), and turning it into clear requirements. jobs.title: Meeloopstage Cash Control/ Finance
jobs.description: Wil jij ontdekken hoe de financiële motor achter een internationale logistiek dienstverlener draait? Ben je nauwkeurig, analytisch en krijg je energie van cijfers die kloppen? Dan is deze meeloopstage iets voor jou! Voor ons Cash Control team in Rotterdam zoeken we een stagiair(e) die meedraait in het dagelijkse cashmanagement. Je helpt bij het tijdig toewijzen van betalingen, het verwerken van bankafschriften en het bewaken van openstaande posten. Je werkt nauw samen met Credit Control, Invoicing en Accounts Payable en doet zo praktijkervaring op met cash application, reconciliaties en werken in ERP-systeem Exact. Waar ga je werken? Royal Den Hartogh Logistics is een internationale, toonaangevende logistiek dienstverlener voor de chemische, gas-, polymeer- en voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Ons familiebedrijf bestaat al sinds 1920 en heeft veiligheid en duurzaamheid stevig in het DNA verankerd. Met 54 locaties in 27 landen en ruim 2.600 collega's wereldwijd werken we continu aan slimme, toekomstbestendige logistieke oplossingen. Ons finance team in Nederland telt 20 collega's, verdeeld over onder andere Credit Control, Invoicing, Accounts Payable en Cash Control – en daar kom jij als stagiair(e) terecht. Wat ga je doen? Je bewaakt de dagelijkse Unallocated Cash : je houdt het overzicht bij, volgt openstaande posten op en rapporteert de belangrijkste KPI's. Je zoekt niet-herkende ontvangsten en niet-gematchte betalingen uit en helpt ze oplossen. Je boekt en verwerkt dagelijks bankafschriften in Exact, voor meerdere bankrekeningen en entiteiten (inkomend en uitgaand). Je matcht klantontvangsten en leveranciersbetalingen aan de juiste facturen. Je helpt bij bankreconciliaties en spoort verschillen op tussen bankafschriften en de administratie. Je denkt mee over verbeteringen om het toewijzen en afletteren efficiënter te maken. De ideale kandidaat Je volgt een mbo4- of hbo-opleiding in een financiële richting, zoals Finance & Control, Bedrijfsadministratie, Bedrijfseconomie

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage Systems & Control - Slimme wisselverwarming
jobs.description: Jouw impact bij Movares Maak wisselverwarming slimmer en bespaar energie op het spoor. Dit ga je doen bij Movares je analyseert weerdata en gegevens van wisselverwarming en onderzoekt verbanden; je onderzoekt hoe een vooruitkijkende regeling het energieverbruik kan verlagen; je ontwikkelt en test een regeling voor het slimmer aansturen van wisselverwarming; je onderzoekt of de regeling technisch toepasbaar is binnen een programmeerbare besturing; je brengt de mogelijke energiebesparing en haalbaarheid van jouw oplossing in beeld. jobs.title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines. Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht. Tijdens deze opdracht analyseer je het volledige machine-inspectieproces en ontwikkel je een vernieuwde werkwijze die aansluit bij de huidige en toekomstige behoeften van onze serviceorganisatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige machine-inspectieproces en het identificeren van verbeterpunten; Het ontwikkelen van een logische en uniforme structuur voor machine-inspecties; Het herformuleren en standaardiseren van bestaande inspectievragen; Het opstellen van duidelijke beoordelingscriteria voor de technische staat van machineonderdelen; Het ontwikkelen van een uniforme methode voor het vastleggen van metingen, bevindingen, foto's en aanbevolen acties; Het verbeteren van inspectierapportages zodat technische bevindingen overzichtelijk, eenduidig en actiegericht worden gepresenteerd; Het opstellen van een implementatievoorstel voor het vernieuwde inspectieproces binnen Customer Service. Het eindresultaat is een praktisch en onderbouwd verbeterplan waarmee Voortman machine-inspecties wereldwijd op een uniforme manier kan uitvoere

jobs.description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked. We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests. Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in. Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them. We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well.
